battle.name: 第二次印巴戰爭
battle.theater: 旁遮普與查穆河谷戰線
battle.brief: 一九六五年九月六日巴基斯坦發動直布羅陀行動越線攻入克什米爾，印軍同日於旁遮普反攻，戰線自錫亞爾科特拉至查姆布與查溫達，查溫達一役雙方坦克正面交鋒。卡面一八四〇年法國雷管步槍未參戰，其雷管擊發確定的有效射程正是本役步槍射擊的源頭。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 第二次印巴戰爭自一九六五年九月六日開火，至一九六六年九月六日在塔什干簽署停火協議、九月十日零時起全面生效，主交戰方是印度與巴基斯坦，戰場橫跨克什米爾控制線、旁遮普—奇利安納瓦拉—拉合爾一線的查姆布公路走廊，以及卡奇之灘的鹽鹼荒漠。印度方面，總理拉爾·巴哈杜爾·夏斯特里掌國，國防部長Y.B.查萬主持軍務，陸軍參謀長是陸軍元帥薩姆·馬內克肖（一九六五年一月接任，其前任K.M.卡里亞帕改任首任聯合參謀長委員會主席），作戰按軍區劃分，主要投入的部隊包括諾迪少將的第一裝甲師、薩加特·辛格少將的第十五步兵師、納亞爾少將的第八山地師、魯德拉少將的第一步兵師，以及第六、第十步兵師和獨立裝甲旅。印度海軍由海軍參謀長科特瓦爾上將統率，以輕型航母INS Vikrant為核心編成特混艦隊；印度空軍由阿爾詹·辛格上將指揮。巴基斯坦方面，總統阿尤布·汗掌握軍權，總理兼外交部長佐勒菲卡爾·阿里·布托主持外交，陸軍參謀長為穆薩·汗上將，陸軍以拉合爾的第一軍區與白沙瓦的第十一軍區為兩大支柱，並在克什米爾方向投入第十二師、第六裝甲師與特種部隊群。關鍵指揮官包括第六裝甲師師長阿布拉爾·侯賽因少將、第二十五步兵師師長M.A.扎基少將、特種部隊群指揮官里亞茲·侯賽因准將，以及率師推進查姆布方向的阿庫德少將。巴基斯坦海軍有驅逐艦Jahangir與Dhola、潛艇Hangor與Gazi，空軍主力為Mirage III、F-86與Canberra。第三方面是中國人民解放軍，其邊防部隊在乃堆拉山口與卓拉山口方向主動攻擊印軍陣地；聯合國安理會先後通過第二一五、二一六、二一七與二二〇號決議，最終由蘇聯在塔什干居中調停。
countriesEn: The Second Indo-Pakistani War opened on 6 September 1965 and was formally ended by the Tashkent ceasefire agreement of 6 September 1966, which took effect at midnight on 10 September 1966. The principal belligerents were India and Pakistan, and the fighting stretched across the Line of Control in Kashmir, the Chhamb road corridor running through the Punjab, Chillianwala and Lahore, and the saline wastes of the Rann of Kutch. On the Indian side the government was led by Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri, the war portfolio was held by Defence Minister Y. B. Chavan, and the Army was commanded by Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw, who had taken over in January 1965, his predecessor K. M. Cariappa having moved on to become the first Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee. Indian operations were organised by corps, and the committed formations included the 1st Armoured Division under Maj Gen A. K. Nandi, the 15th Infantry Division under Maj Gen Sagat Singh, the 8th Mountain Division under Maj Gen D. K. Nayar, the 1st Infantry Division under Maj Gen A. A. Rudra, the 6th and 10th Infantry Divisions and the independent armoured brigades. The Indian Navy, under Chief of Naval Staff Vice Admiral A. D. Kotwal, formed a task force built around the light carrier INS Vikrant, and the Indian Air Force was led by Air Marshal Arjan Singh. On the Pakistani side, President Ayub Khan held the military power, Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto conducted foreign affairs, and General Musa Khan commanded the army. The army's two main pillars were the I Corps at Lahore and the XI Corps at Peshawar, with the 12th Division, the 6th Armoured Division and the Special Forces Group committed in Kashmir. The key commanders included Maj Gen Abrar Hussain of the 6th Armoured Division, Maj Gen M. A. Zaki of the 25th Infantry Division, Brigadier Riaz Hussain who commanded the Special Forces Group, and Maj Gen Akhund, whose 12th Division drove the thrust towards Chhamb. The Pakistan Navy fielded the destroyers Jahangir and Dhola and the submarines Hangor and Gazi, while the Pakistan Air Force was built around the Mirage III, the F-86 and the Canberra. A third party was the Chinese People's Liberation Army, whose border troops attacked Indian positions in the Nathu La and Cho La sectors. The United Nations Security Council adopted Resolutions 215, 216, 217 and 220, and the eventual ceasefire was mediated by the Soviet Union in Tashkent.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩國的最高統帥與前線指揮官。印度的夏斯特里在開戰初期刻意保持克制，拒絕把戰事擴散到印巴以外的戰線，並頂住盟邦要求出兵介入的壓力，實際作戰策劃由參謀總部主持，馬內克肖以陸軍元帥身分拍板前沿的裝甲與空降部署；國防部長查萬於九月八日批准在旁遮普方向發動代號為Vijay的有限進攻，目標是切斷拉合爾通往查穆的公路並施壓於巴基斯坦縱深。前線指派上，薩加特·辛格少將率第十五步兵師沿奇利安納瓦拉—查姆布軸線壓上，諾迪少將率第一裝甲師自菲洛爾向拉合爾外廓推進，納亞爾少將的第八山地師負責封鎖查穆河谷北面的通路，魯德拉少將的第一步兵師則在卡奇之灘方向抵擋巴基斯坦的推進；印度空軍由阿爾詹·辛格上將主導先發反擊與攔截作戰，海軍方面則由維克蘭特號的艦隊司令部與直轄飛行中隊共同執行四天的直升機作戰。巴基斯坦方面，阿尤布·汗總統在塔什干會晤未取得成果後批准軍事方案，布托則以放棄公投、維持現有控制線為談判前提，堅持要求印軍先撤出克什米爾；穆薩·汗上將統率全軍，阿布拉爾·侯賽因少將在查溫達以第六裝甲師擋住印度第一裝甲師，扎基少將的第二十五步兵師在菲洛爾迎擊印軍裝甲先鋒，里亞茲·侯賽因准將率突擊縱隊越過控制線，阿庫德少將的第十二師則沿查姆布方向推進。中國方面，解放軍在乃堆拉山口主動出擊，向印軍施加壓力，成為牽制印軍將北面兵力南調的重要因素。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities were the supreme commanders and the field commanders of the two states. In India, Shastri deliberately kept the war limited in the first weeks, refused to widen it beyond the subcontinent and resisted pressure from allies to intervene; operational planning was run by the General Staff Headquarters, and Manekshaw, as Field Marshal, sanctioned the forward deployment of armour and airborne troops. Defence Minister Chavan approved the limited offensive in the Punjab on 8 September, code-named Vijay, whose aims were to cut the Lahore–Jammu road and put pressure on Pakistan's depth. On the ground, Maj Gen Sagat Singh led the 15th Infantry Division along the Chillianwala–Chhamb axis, Maj Gen Nandi took the 1st Armoured Division forward from Phillora towards the approaches to Lahore, Maj Gen Nayar's 8th Mountain Division sealed the northern approaches into the Kashmir Valley, and Maj Gen Rudra's 1st Infantry Division checked the Pakistani advance in the Rann of Kutch. Air Marshal Arjan Singh directed Indian counter-air and interdiction operations, while at sea the flagship INS Vikrant and its embarked fighter squadron together ran four days of helicopter operations. On the Pakistani side President Ayub Khan approved the military plan after the Tashkent meeting had produced nothing, while Bhutto made the withdrawal of Indian troops from Kashmir and the abandonment of the plebiscite the preconditions of any settlement, and General Musa Khan commanded the army. Maj Gen Abrar Hussain used the 6th Armoured Division at Chawinda to stop the Indian 1st Armoured Division, Maj Gen Zaki's 25th Infantry Division met the Indian armour thrust at Phillora, Brigadier Riaz Hussain led the strike columns across the Line of Control, and Maj Gen Akhund's 12th Division pushed along the Chhamb axis. On the Chinese side the People's Liberation Army attacked on its own initiative in the Nathu La sector, applying pressure that tied down Indian forces and drew them north.
kits: 卡面那支一八四〇年法國雷管步槍本身並未出現在一九六五年的戰場，但它確立的技術路線——雷管擊發配合膛線米涅彈——正是本役雙方步兵武器的共同源頭。印度步兵主要使用改膛七點六二公厘李-恩菲爾德步槍，以及一九六五年才開始列裝的五點五六公厘自動步槍（SLR，即FN FAL的印度仿製型，印度也因此成為最早大量採用北約五點五六公厘口徑的國家）；近戰用九公厘史丹利衝鋒槍，反裝甲有三點七吋維加達反戰車砲與一百零六公厘無後坐力砲，支援火力為八十一公厘、一百二十公厘迫擊砲以及二十五磅野戰砲和一百零五公厘榴彈砲。巴基斯坦步兵以改膛七點六二公厘毛瑟步槍與李-恩菲爾德為主，同樣配發九公厘衝鋒槍，在山區還大量使用當地土製步槍；反戰車同樣靠三點七吋砲與無後坐力砲，砲兵有一百零五公厘榴彈砲與英製二十五磅砲。裝甲方面，印度第一裝甲師配M4A3雪曼式坦克（印度自製型）、Centurion主戰坦克與Alvis 6X4薩拉丁式偵察車，巴基斯坦第六裝甲師配M48與M47巴頓式坦克、凱旋式坦克及裝甲偵察車，雙方都以半履帶裝甲車輸送步兵。空軍裝備上，印度有Hawker Hunter戰鬥機、Dassault Mystère IV型戰鬥轟炸機、MiG-21FL攔截機、Su-7戰鬥機與Canberra轟炸機；巴基斯坦有Mirage III戰鬥機、F-86佩刀式戰鬥機、Canberra轟炸機與哈爾濱式殲擊機。海軍方面，印度以INS Vikrant輕型航母、巡洋艦Vigour、驅逐艦Subhash、反潛驅逐艦Khukri與Mahadev為骨幹，巴基斯坦有驅逐艦Jahangir與Dhola以及常規潛艇Hangor與Gazi。運輸依靠C-47、C-130與公路車隊，進入克什米爾的巴基斯坦突擊縱隊則主要靠騾馬馱運補給。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle of 1840 shown on the card never appeared on a 1965 battlefield, but the technical line it established — percussion ignition combined with the rifled Minié ball — is the common ancestor of the infantry weapons on both sides. The Indian infantry fought mainly with 7.62mm Lee-Enfield rifles rechambered for the NATO cartridge and with the 5.56mm Self-Loading Rifle, an Indian-built copy of the FN FAL that was only entering service in 1965, which made India the first major user of the NATO 5.56mm calibre. Close combat was handled with the 9mm Sterling submachine gun; anti-armour weapons were the 3.7-inch Vijay Dhan gun and the 106mm recoilless rifle; and the supporting artillery included 81mm and 120mm mortars together with the 25-pounder field gun and the 105mm howitzer. The Pakistani infantry relied on 7.62mm Mauser and Lee-Enfield rifles with the same 9mm submachine guns, plus a great many locally made country rifles in the mountain areas, and relied on 3.7-inch guns and recoilless rifles for anti-armour work with 105mm howitzers and British 25-pounders for artillery. In armoured terms the Indian 1st Armoured Division was equipped with M4A3 Sherman tanks of Indian manufacture, Centurion battle tanks and Alvis 6X4 Saladin reconnaissance vehicles, while the Pakistani 6th Armoured Division fielded M48 and M47 Patton tanks, Centurions and armoured cars; both sides used half-tracks to move infantry. In the air the Indian Air Force had the Hawker Hunter, the Dassault Mystère IV, the MiG-21FL, the Su-7 and the Canberra bomber, while Pakistan had the Mirage III, the F-86 Sabre, Canberras and Chinese Harbin fighters. At sea the Indian order of battle was built around the light carrier INS Vikrant, the cruiser Vigour, the destroyer Subhash and the anti-submarine destroyers Khukri and Mahadev; Pakistan had the destroyers Jahangir and Dhola and the conventional submarines Hangor and Gazi. Movement depended on the C-47 and C-130 and on road convoys, while the Pakistani strike columns that pushed into Kashmir were supplied largely by mule trains.
tactics: 巴基斯坦的核心戰術是夜間滲透。九月六日凌晨，特種部隊群分成八至十個縱隊，自控制線多處翻越山脊，每縱隊人數從數十到數百不等，輕裝徒步穿插，目標是奪取斯利那加外圍與山區要點，再以工兵在餘震中打通通往穆扎法巴德的路線；第十二師主力其後才沿查姆布向奇利安納瓦拉推進，意圖切斷斯利那加與查穆之間的唯一公路，即查穆河谷的補給命脈，卻被印軍第十五步兵師正面防禦配合第八山地師的縱深反擊擋住。旁遮普方面，九月八日印度發動代號Vijay的進攻，第一裝甲師配所屬裝甲旅沿菲洛爾—拉合爾軸線推進，第十五步兵師向查姆布以東展開，企圖直取拉合爾；但巴基斯坦第六裝甲師早已在查溫達一線佔領反斜面陣地，用交叉火力和預先射擊封住裝甲矛頭，雙方在查溫達反覆拉鋸到九月中下旬。空戰上，巴基斯坦空軍九月一日先發打擊印度本土九座空軍基地，以Mirage III攜炸彈與火箭彈攻擊跑道與機庫；印度空軍在九月十日組織最大規模攔截戰，出動Hawker Hunter與Mystère攔截Mirage III，並在拉合爾、費齊爾卡與錫亞爾科特上空反覆周旋。海軍方面，INS Vikrant自薩加爾島起降，九月十四日至十七日連續四天以Sea King直昇機搭載MiG-21與Gnat戰鬥機執行對岸攻擊，九月十八日巡洋艦Vigour再以魚雷攻擊Dhola。水陸協同方面，巴基斯坦以卡奇之灘方向與乃堆拉山口施壓，分散印度本已吃緊的兵力。
tacticsEn: Pakistan's central tactic was infiltration at night. In the small hours of 6 September the Special Forces Group split into eight to ten columns which crossed the Line of Control at many points, each column ranging from several dozen men to several hundred, lightly equipped and moving on foot, with the object of seizing the approaches to Srinagar and the key heights before engineers opened a route to Muzaffarabad in the aftermath of the shelling. Only later did the bulk of the 12th Division push along the Chhamb towards Chillianwala, aiming to sever the single road linking Srinagar to Jammu — the supply artery of the Kashmir Valley — but the Indian 15th Infantry Division, with the 8th Mountain Division counter-attacking in depth, blocked the road. In the Punjab, on 8 September, India launched the operation code-named Vijay, with the 1st Armoured Division and its armoured brigades advancing along the Phillora–Lahore axis and the 15th Infantry Division driving east of Chhamb in an attempt to take Lahore itself. Pakistan's 6th Armoured Division had already occupied reverse-slope positions on the Chawinda line, sealing the armoured spearhead with crossfire and prepared shots, and the two sides fought over Chawinda back and forth until the second half of September. In the air, the Pakistan Air Force struck nine Indian airfields on the home territory on 1 September with Mirage IIIs carrying bombs and rockets against the runways and the revetments; the Indian Air Force mounted its largest interception of the war on 10 September, committing Hawker Hunters and Mystères against Mirage IIIs and manoeuvring repeatedly over Lahore, Fazilka and Sialkot. At sea INS Vikrant operated from Sagar island and, from 14 to 17 September, flew four consecutive days of attacks with MiG-21 and Gnat fighters ferried out in Sea King helicopters, and on 18 September the cruiser Vigour torpedoed Dhola. In the theatre as a whole, pressure from the Rann of Kutch and the Nathu La front stretched Indian forces already committed in the north.
data: 時間跨度：一九六五年九月六日開戰，至一九六六年九月六日在塔什干簽署停火協議、九月十日零時起全面生效，前後約十二個月，決定性的地面戰鬥集中在首月。兵力：印度動員約二十萬人，巴基斯坦約十二萬人，雙方在旁遮普與查穆方向各投入十餘個師。裝甲戰：查溫達一役自九月七日至十六日，是史上規模最大的坦克會戰，巴基斯坦第六裝甲師投入約一百二十至一百五十輛坦克，印度第一裝甲師投入約二百至三百輛；九月二日的菲洛爾之戰約有一百五十輛坦克交戰，印軍損失十輛M4A3雪曼，巴軍損失八輛M48巴頓，全役雙方坦克永久損失以數十輛計。空軍：九月一日巴基斯坦空軍對印度境內九座基地投擲一百二十八枚炸彈並發射一百二十八枚火箭彈；九月十日最大規模空戰中，印度空軍宣稱擊落巴基斯坦空軍三架Canberra轟炸機、一架Mirage III與兩架MiG-19，雙方實際各有數架戰機損失。海軍：驅逐艦Jahangir於九月十六日在卡拉奇外海被擊沉；九月十八日Dhola被巡洋艦Vigour發射的魚雷擊中受創；十月一日印度反潛驅逐艦Khukri被巴基斯坦潛艇Hangor以魚雷擊沉，全艦三百餘名官兵殉艦；十二月十四日巴基斯坦潛艇Gazi又被驅逐艦Mahadev擊沉於卡拉奇外海。傷亡：印度官方公布陣亡一千六百五十五人、受傷四千六百二十一人；巴基斯坦方面公布陣亡約一千七百七十九人、受傷約五千一百三十八人。山口方向，九月十一日與十月十一日的乃堆拉、卓拉衝突中，中印雙方各有數百人死傷。
dataEn: Duration: the war opened on 6 September 1965 and was closed by the Tashkent ceasefire agreement of 6 September 1966, effective from midnight on 10 September 1966 — some twelve months in all, with the decisive ground fighting concentrated in the first month. Manpower: India mobilised roughly 200,000 men and Pakistan about 120,000, with more than a dozen divisions committed by each side in the Punjab and in Jammu. Armoured fighting: the Battle of Chawinda, from 7 to 16 September, was the largest tank engagement in history, with Pakistan's 6th Armoured Division committing about 120 to 150 tanks and India's 1st Armoured Division about 200 to 300; the Battle of Phillora on 2 September involved some 150 tanks, with India losing ten M4A3 Shermans and Pakistan eight M48 Pattons, and permanent tank losses across the whole war numbering in the tens. In the air, the Pakistan Air Force dropped 128 bombs and fired 128 rockets against nine Indian bases on 1 September; in the largest air engagement of the war on 10 September the Indian Air Force claimed three Pakistani Canberras, one Mirage III and two MiG-19s destroyed, and both sides in fact lost a small number of aircraft. At sea the destroyer Jahangir was sunk off Karachi on 16 September; Dhola was torpedoed and damaged by the cruiser Vigour on 18 September; the Indian anti-submarine destroyer Khukri was torpedoed and sunk by the Pakistani submarine Hangor on 1 October, all of her three hundred-odd officers and men going down with her; and the Pakistani submarine Gazi was sunk by the destroyer Mahadev off Karachi on 14 December. Casualties: India officially reported 1,655 dead and 4,621 wounded, while Pakistan reported about 1,779 dead and about 5,138 wounded. In the mountain sectors, the clashes at Nathu La on 11 September and at Cho La on 11 October cost both the Chinese and the Indian sides several hundred men each.
cause: 導火索是克什米爾主權爭議長期無解。一九四七年印巴分治留下的控制線從未由國際協議劃定，一九六二年《西姆拉協議》雖約定以公民投票解決爭端，卻一直沒有落實；一九六五年八月阿尤布·汗與布托在塔什干會商，布托堅持要求印度軍隊撤出克什米爾、並拒絕公投，回國後軍方隨即以代號「直布羅陀」的計畫籌劃越線作戰，以軍事既成事實迫使談判。水資源爭端同時升溫：印度在卡奇之灘興建水壩與取水設施，兩國在卡奇之灘方向已於同年四月爆發小規模交火，經世界銀行調解才暫時平息，而印度河用水的分配仲裁要到一九六八年才有結果，正式條約更遲至一九六六年一月才簽署。國際層面上，蘇聯在一九六五年年中勸說印度不要支持巴基斯坦的軍事方案未能奏效，戰爭爆發後又迅速轉為勸和；英美明確表示不介入，南亞國家多半保持中立。直接開火點是九月六日凌晨的直布羅陀行動，而九月一日巴基斯坦空軍對印度空軍基地的先發打擊，則把衝突由地面同時推到空中。
causeEn: The spark was a Kashmir dispute that had never been settled. The Line of Control left behind by the 1947 partition was never delimited by international agreement, and although the 1962 Simla Agreement provided for a plebiscite, that provision was never carried out. In August 1965 Ayub Khan and Bhutto met in Tashkent, where Bhutto insisted that Indian troops should withdraw from Kashmir and that the plebiscite should be abandoned; on returning home the army immediately began planning the operation code-named Gibraltar, seeking to force negotiations by creating military facts on the ground. The water dispute was heating up at the same time: India was building dams and diversion works in the Rann of Kutch, small clashes had already occurred in the Rann in April 1965 and were only settled temporarily through World Bank mediation, and the arbitration of the Indus waters was not to produce a result until 1968, with the formal treaty signed only in January 1966. At the international level the Soviet Union tried during the middle of 1965 to dissuade India from backing the Pakistani military plan without success, then shifted quickly to mediation once the war began; Britain and the United States made it clear that they would not intervene, and most South Asian states stayed neutral. The immediate trigger was the Gibraltar operation in the early hours of 6 September, while the Pakistan Air Force strike on Indian air bases on 1 September extended the conflict from the ground to the air as well.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了兩國的國防結構與外交取向。印度在戰後加速推動國產化，五點五六公厘SLR成為裝備重點，國防研究機構與航天機構相繼成立，一九七四年更完成核試；軍事理論上確立以縱深打擊與裝甲機動作戰為核心的取向，長期執行的前進政策則在克什米爾方向埋下日後爭端。巴基斯坦在一九六六年轉入阿尤布·汗的獨裁體制，軍方權力膨脹，軍費長期佔國家開支的大頭，成為一九七一年財政與政治危機的導火線；停火線沿用至今，被稱為實際控制線，而查穆河谷與錫亞欽之間的邊界從未劃定，一九八四年錫亞欽冰川衝突正源於此。聯合國安理會第二一五至二二〇號決議確立了大國不介入、南亞國家自行解決的處理框架，聯合國維持觀察團在邊境核查直到戰後仍在進行。長期後果是印巴軍備競賽全面升級，核武、導彈與航空工業都自此獲得最高優先級，一九七一年第三次印巴戰爭幾乎是一九六五年經驗的重演，兵種建設、協同作戰與後勤組織上的教訓，以及方向相反的誤判，都被雙方原樣繼承。
impactEn: The war reshaped the defence structures and the foreign policies of both states. India accelerated its drive for self-sufficiency after the fighting: the 5.56mm SLR became the centrepiece of re-equipment, defence research and space agencies were established in succession, and the country went on to test a nuclear device in 1974. Doctrineally, India settled on deep operations and mechanised manoeuvre as the core of its approach, and the forward policy it had pursued for years left a standing grievance along the Kashmir front. Pakistan moved under Ayub Khan into a one-man system in 1966; the army's power grew, defence spending took an ever larger share of national expenditure, and this became a trigger of the fiscal and political crisis of 1971. The ceasefire line survives as the Line of Control, while the boundary between the Kashmir Valley and the Siachen has never been delimited — the 1984 Siachen conflict grew directly out of that ambiguity. Security Council Resolutions 215 to 220 established the framework of non-intervention by the great powers with the South Asian states resolving their own quarrel, and the United Nations kept a military observer mission on the frontier well into the post-war period. The long-term consequence was a comprehensive escalation of the Indo-Pakistani arms race, with nuclear weapons, missiles and the aircraft industry all elevated to the highest priority, and the Third Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 was in effect a re-run of 1965, both sides inheriting the lessons of arm development, joint operations and logistics, together with the mistakes that ran the other way.
result: 一九六六年九月六日，阿尤布·汗與夏斯特里在蘇聯調停下於塔什干簽署停火協議，九月十日零時起全面生效，雙方大致回到戰前態勢。巴基斯坦的突擊縱隊被逐回控制線南側，第十二師在查姆布的推進遭擊退，查姆布以南的突出部在戰役末段被印軍縱深反擊消滅，但哈吉皮爾突出部始終在巴軍手中，直到一九七一年第三次印巴戰爭才被收復；查溫達以南的菲洛爾突出部在九月中旬被印軍奪回，九月二十九日托爾馬亦重新落入印度控制。印度第一裝甲師在拉合爾外圍的推進被止住，未能攻入巴基斯坦本土，第十五步兵師向查姆布以東的擴張同樣未能達成目標，錫亞欽與阿克賽姆一帶的控制權最終仍歸印度，但界線未劃。國際上，一九六六年一月的塔什干宣言與印度河用水條約相繼簽署，兩國就水資源分配達成可接受的安排，戰事以雙方都能向國內交代的方式收束，然而克什米爾問題本身一點也沒有解決。
resultEn: On 6 September 1966 Ayub Khan and Shastri signed a ceasefire agreement in Tashkent under Soviet mediation, effective from midnight on 10 September, and the two sides returned in broad terms to their pre-war positions. The Pakistani strike columns were driven back south of the Line of Control and the 12th Division's advance along Chhamb was checked, the salient south of Chhamb being eliminated by Indian counter-attacks in depth in the closing weeks of the fighting. The Hajipir salient, however, stayed in Pakistani hands and was not retaken until the Third Indo-Pakistani War of 1971. The Phillora salient south of Chawinda was recaptured by the Indians in the middle of September, and Torma returned to Indian control on 29 September. The advance of the Indian 1st Armoured Division towards Lahore was stopped in the approaches and never broke into Pakistani territory, while the eastward expansion of the 15th Infantry Division beyond Chhamb likewise failed; the Siachen and Aksum sectors stayed in Indian hands, but no line was drawn there. Internationally the Tashkent Declaration and the Indus Waters Treaty were signed in January 1966, giving both states a settlement on the distribution of river water that each could defend at home. The war was thus closed in a manner both governments could present to their own public, but the Kashmir question itself was not settled by a single metre.
